description: This Java class 'ThemeFactory' is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model' package and manages widget theme models in the Ofbiz framework. It provides functionalities to load, cache, and retrieve theme models and visual themes from XML files, as well as resolve the active theme based on user session, preferences, or default settings.

classes.name: ThemeFactory
classes.description: A final class providing methods to load, cache, and resolve widget themes and visual themes within the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: readThemeDocument
methods.description: Creates a ModelTheme instance from an XML Document representing a theme.

methods.name: pullModelThemesFromXmlToCache
methods.description: Reloads all visual themes by reading theme XML files and updating the internal cache.

methods.name: checkForWidgetFolder
methods.description: Helper method that scans a folder path for 'widget' subfolders and identifies theme XML files within them.

methods.name: getThemeXmlFiles
methods.description: Scans the OFBiz themes and plugins directories for theme XML files.

methods.name: getVisualThemeFromId
methods.description: Retrieves a VisualTheme object from cache by ID, refilling cache if necessary.

methods.name: getModelThemeFromLocation
methods.description: Resolves and loads a ModelTheme from a given resource location, caching the result.

methods.name: getAvailableThemes
methods.description: Returns a list of visual themes available for a specified theme set, combining cache and database data.

methods.name: resolveVisualTheme
methods.description: Determines the active visual theme based on session, user preferences, request parameters, or defaults.
